This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection

 director.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by 
 accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, 
 quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control head sector.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc

items: Disconnected completely.
Secure against re-connection.
Verify that the installation is dead.
Carry out earthing and short circuiting.
Provide protection against adjacent live parts.
Safety helmet, safety beet, and tool set
DC 1000 V megger
Air blower and brushes
Fine cloth for cleaning purpose
PVC ladders, breathing mask, rags
Wearing and maintenance labels present and well readable
Operating and maintenance instructions on site and up to date
Doors and fences around switchyard in proper condition.
All cable channels protected by covers.
Free access to emergency exits.
Switchyard, indoor and emergency lighting in proper service conditions
All operating and maintenance tools available
Important spare parts available
Clean pedestals and steel structures, check no visible corrosion.

Check that all metallic parts (switchgear, structures, and fences) are well connected to 
 earthing grid.

Check that porcelain insulators are without cracks and pollution. No traces from partial 
 discharges (visual inspection with glass)
Check that screwed connections are without missing or loose bolts and nuts.
Inspect the high voltage connections by glass.
Check that there is no standing alarms or unusual signals.
Check of indication signals by lamp test.
Check that there is no unusual noises or smells on the switchgears.
Check that the indicating and measuring instruments are working.

Introduction
This document outlines the visual inspection I1, which must be carried out 
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the 
 title block.
This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection 
 quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar Al Aresh PS general 
 director.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by 
 accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, 
 quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Disconnected completely.
Secure against re-connection.
Verify that the installation is dead.
Carry out earthing and short circuiting.
Provide protection against adjacent live parts.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety beet, and tool set
DC 1000 V megger
Air blower and brushes
Fine cloth for cleaning purpose
PVC ladders, breathing mask, rags
Work to be Carried out
General Checks
Wearing and maintenance labels present and well readable
Operating and maintenance instructions on site and up to date
Doors and fences around switchyard in proper condition.
All cable channels protected by covers.
Free access to emergency exits.
Switchyard, indoor and emergency lighting in proper service conditions
All operating and maintenance tools available
Important spare parts available
Mechanical Checks
Clean pedestals and steel structures, check no visible corrosion.
Check that all metallic parts (switchgear, structures, and fences) are well connected to 
 earthing grid.
Check that porcelain insulators are without cracks and pollution. No traces from partial 
 discharges (visual inspection with glass)
Check that screwed connections are without missing or loose bolts and nuts.
Inspect the high voltage connections by glass.
Electrical Checks
Check that there is no standing alarms or unusual signals.
Check of indication signals by lamp test.
Check that there is no unusual noises or smells on the switchgears.
Check that the indicating and measuring instruments are working.
Return the Circuit Breaker into 
Service
Disconnect the earthing and short circulating.
Ensure that there is no any tools or any cleaning materials in the work area.
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area.
Finish the work permit with coordination with shift 
 engineer.
